name: paretostudio-mcp
description: Read your ParetoStudio prompt, agent, and skill library from Claude — and install agents and skills into your projects.
long_description: ParetoStudio is where you build and organize prompts, agents, and skills. This extension connects Claude to your library: list, search, and read prompts, agents, and skills; create and update them without leaving the conversation; and install agents and skills as files into Claude Code projects. Requires a free ParetoStudio account and an API key (Settings → Developer).

api_key.title: ParetoStudio API Key
api_key.description: Starts with psk_. Create one at paretostudio.io → Settings → Developer.
